tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Enhance your business communication with the SNOM D862 8-SIP PoE Desk Black IP Phone Set – a professional VoIP phone designed for corporate offices, call centers, and enterprises in Bangladesh. With support for up to 8 SIP accounts, this desk phone allows seamless multitasking, efficient call management, and crystal-clear HD audio. Its high-resolution graphical display and intuitive interface make navigating features easy, while Power over Ethernet (PoE) ensures flexible installation without the need for an external adapter.


The SNOM D862 is perfect for high-demand office environments, offering programmable keys, dual Gigabit Ethernet ports, and advanced VoIP features such as BLF (Busy Lamp Field), call forwarding, and conferencing. Its ergonomic design ensures comfort during long working hours, making it an ideal choice for call centers and professional communication setups across Bangladesh.


Key Technical Specifications

  • Model: SNOM D862
  • SIP Accounts: Up to 8 SIP identities/accounts
  • Display: High-resolution backlit graphical display
  • Audio: Wideband HD audio, full-duplex speakerphone, acoustic echo cancellation
  • Connectivity: Dual Gigabit Ethernet ports (10/100/1000 Mbps), PoE supported
  • Keys: Multiple programmable function keys, context-sensitive soft keys, navigation keys
  • Protocols & Security: SIP 2.0, SRTP, TLS, VLAN support, QoS (DiffServ)
  • Design: Ergonomic black desk phone with adjustable stand
  • Power: PoE powered (adapter not included)
  • Advanced Features: Call transfer, hold, forwarding, conferencing, voicemail access, BLF, auto-provisioning
  • Ideal For: Corporate offices, call centers, enterprise VoIP systems, and professional communication setups in Bangladesh
